DISTRIBUTION OF SUPPORT VOUCHERS 
(Fukuyama City Resident Cost-of-Living Support Voucher Program) 
 
If you have not received your vouchers, please contact us! 
Postcards (reminder notices) were sent on June 1 to those who had not received their 
vouchers as of May 14. 
If you have received the postcard, please contact the Implementation Office (☎084-921-
2111) or the inquiry counter as soon as possible. 
If you do not contact us, you may no longer be able to receive the vouchers. 
 
1. Overview of Project 
Utilizing the national government's Focused Support Local Allocation Grant, support 
vouchers (JCB Gift Cards) were sent out starting in late February to support residents 
affected by rising prices. *No application is required. 
 
Eligible Recipients 
Individuals who are registered as residents of Fukuyama City on the reference date 
(January 1, 2026). 
 
Amount 
5,000 yen per person (Five 1,000-yen vouchers) 
*An additional 5,000 yen amount in vouchers per person will be added for individuals 
belonging to households exempt from residence tax, or households subject only to the per 
capita rate of residence tax. 
 
Support Voucher Type 
JCB Gift Card 
• These support vouchers do not have an expiration date. However, as they are 
being distributed to combat the rising cost of living, please use them as soon as 
possible. 
• Please note that change (cash back) will not be given when using these gift support 
vouchers. 
• Please be aware that Fukuyama City assumes no responsibility for the theft, 
burning, loss, or destruction of the support vouchers. 
 
Beware of Scams 
Please be cautious of suspicious phone calls and scams where individuals posing as city 
Fukuyama City 
 
 
employees or other officials ask for bank account or credit card numbers, or request you to 
operate an ATM. If you receive a suspicious call, please consult your nearest police station 
or the Police Safety Consultation Hotline (♯9110). 
 
2. Method of Distribution ※No application required 
No application was required. From February 21 (Sat.), vouchers were sent in order over 
approximately one month to the head of each household (based on the registered address 
and head of household as of the reference date) by Yu-Pack (white Kaku-2 envelope). 
Face-to-face delivery is required.  
If you have submitted a change-of-address notice to the post office, the package will be 
forwarded to your new address. 
 
3. List of Stores in Fukuyama City Where the Vouchers Can Be Used 
For information on participating merchants, please contact the Implementation Office. 
 
4. Contact Information 
Fukuyama City Resident Cost-of-Living Support Voucher Program Implementation Office 
Telephone: 084-921-2111 
Hours: 8:30 a.m. – 5:15 p.m. (Closed on Saturdays, Sundays, and public holidays) 
Service Counters 
Citizens’ Consultation Division (1st Floor, Fukuyama City Hall Main Office)
